description: This PHP source file implements a web page for changing user passwords, including client-side validation, password visibility toggle, and server communication for updating the password.

methods.name: getInstanceNum
methods.description: Determines the instance number based on the current logged-in username.

methods.name: cancel_save
methods.description: Redirects the user to 'at_a_glance.php' when password change is canceled.

methods.name: set_config
methods.description: Sends the new password configuration to the server and handles the response, including success or failure alerts.

methods.name: next_step
methods.description: Validates and collects form data, then initiates the password change process.
